entries.en: none
entries.desc: 不指定光學效果，讓模型自行決定是否加入 flare、散景、柔焦、暗角等鏡頭特徵。

entries.en: heavy bokeh rendering, large out-of-focus highlight discs, aperture-shaped blur circles, pronounced background or foreground defocus highlights, optical blur balls
entries.desc: 讓離焦高光形成大型光斑或光圈形狀，重點是散景形狀、尺寸與離焦高光的光學表現。

entries.en: swirly bokeh rendering, curved out-of-focus background highlights circling around the subject, vintage edge swirl, rotational peripheral blur character
entries.desc: 背景散景在畫面邊緣形成旋繞流動感，重點是復古鏡頭式的周邊旋渦散景，而不是單純背景模糊。

entries.en: cat-eye bokeh rendering, oval edge highlights near the frame perimeter, lens-edge compression of blur discs, stretched off-axis background bokeh
entries.desc: 畫面邊緣的散景光斑被拉成貓眼形橢圓，重點是離軸位置的鏡頭邊緣散景特徵。

entries.en: soap-bubble bokeh rendering, bright-rimmed blur circles, hollow-edged highlight discs, vintage triplet-lens background highlights, crisp bubble-like specular outlines
entries.desc: 散景光斑邊緣有明亮輪廓、中央較空，形成像肥皂泡般的老鏡式高光圓圈。

entries.id: camera:光學效果-optical-effects:前景遮擋散景:5
legacyIds: camera:光學效果-optical-effects:前景遮擋散景:5
entries.en: blurred foreground occlusion near the lens, out-of-focus shapes crossing one or more frame edges, meaningful partial frame coverage, thick near-field bokeh veil, clear opening toward the subject
entries.desc: 鏡頭前方有失焦遮擋物形成近景模糊層，必須遮住部分畫面邊緣或局部視線，但保留能看清主體的開口與前景深度層次。

entries.id: camera:光學效果-optical-effects:玻璃前景折射:6
legacyIds: camera:光學效果-optical-effects:玻璃前景折射:6
entries.en: foreground glass refraction near the lens, transparent distorted shapes crossing the frame, warped highlights, refracted subject-edge fragments, clear central viewing opening
entries.desc: 像隔著玻璃、透明板或水晶邊緣拍攝，畫面前景帶透明折射扭曲，但仍保留能看見主體的清楚開口。

entries.en: prism refraction effect, split-image fragments, rainbow spectral streaks, duplicated edge reflections, crystalline light scattering near the frame
entries.desc: 利用稜鏡或折射介質讓畫面邊緣出現分裂影像、彩虹色譜與晶體式反射碎片。

entries.en: starburst diffraction spikes on bright point lights, crisp radiating light rays, stopped-down aperture sparkle, sharp multi-point highlight stars
entries.desc: 明亮點光源產生清楚放射狀星芒，重點是光圈繞射形成的多角星形高光。

entries.en: lens flare artifacts, internal lens reflections, veiling flare, ghosting shapes, streaking flare artifacts from a strong off-axis light source
entries.desc: 強光進入鏡頭後造成內部反射、鬼影、光暈或條狀 flare，重點是鏡頭內部反射瑕疵。

entries.zh: 變形鏡頭光斑 Anamorphic Flare
entries.en: anamorphic lens flare artifacts, horizontal flare streaks, cylindrical lens reflection behavior, oval bokeh response, stretched optical highlights
entries.desc: 變形鏡頭造成水平 flare、橢圓散景與被拉伸的高光反射，重點是柱面光學特徵。

entries.id: camera:光學效果-optical-effects:局部炫光霧面反差:11
legacyIds: camera:光學效果-optical-effects:局部炫光霧面反差:11
entries.en: localized veiling flare, partial low-contrast haze around strong light entry, washed highlight patching, matte glare bloom without full-frame fog
entries.desc: 局部強光進入鏡頭後形成一塊對比下降的霧面炫光區，像鍍膜失守或半片式 glare，而不是整張都起霧。

entries.en: analog film light leak artifacts, irregular edge exposure burns, translucent red-orange film-gate leaks, uneven accidental exposure streaks, frame-edge chemical light contamination
entries.desc: 模擬底片或膠片匣漏光造成的不規則邊緣曝光、暖色光痕與局部化學感覆蓋。

entries.en: soft focus diffusion filter, lowered microcontrast, softened fine detail, gentle glow around high-contrast edges, preserved overall facial and subject structure
entries.desc: 柔焦或擴散濾鏡降低微對比與細節銳度，在高反差邊緣產生柔和暈散，但仍保留主體結構。

entries.en: highlight bloom, halation around bright areas, local luminance bleeding, softened highlight edges, optical glow spill limited to high-value regions
entries.desc: 高亮區域邊緣向外暈散，形成局部亮度溢出與 halation，重點是高光反應而非整體場景狀態。

entries.en: optical vignetting, darker frame corners, radial edge exposure falloff, center-weighted brightness, subtle lens shading toward the image perimeter
entries.desc: 鏡頭邊緣進光量下降，畫面角落與邊緣呈現徑向變暗，中心亮度相對更集中。

entries.en: chromatic aberration, subtle RGB edge fringing, lateral color separation along high-contrast edges, minor lens dispersion artifact
entries.desc: 高反差邊緣出現輕微 RGB 分離或彩色邊，重點是鏡片色散造成的光學瑕疵。

entries.en: peripheral edge blur, center sharpness with soft frame edges, field curvature softness, reduced corner resolution, lens falloff away from the image center
entries.desc: 中心解析較高，越接近畫面邊緣越柔，模擬場曲、邊角解析下降或鏡頭周邊成像衰減。

entries.id: camera:光學效果-optical-effects:中央清晰邊緣拉抹:18
legacyIds: camera:光學效果-optical-effects:中央清晰邊緣拉抹:18
entries.en: sharp center with smeared frame edges, radial edge stretching, directional peripheral blur, center-held subject clarity, warped outer image field
entries.desc: 中央主體相對清楚，但畫面外圈有明顯方向性拉抹與扭曲，像低品質濾鏡或實驗鏡片造成的邊緣拖拽感。

entries.id: camera:光學效果-optical-effects:光學朦朧薄霧:19
legacyIds: camera:光學效果-optical-effects:光學朦朧薄霧:19
entries.en: lens-only mist-filter haze, veiling glare, lowered global contrast, softened black levels, diffused highlight edges, optical diffusion layer
entries.desc: 像鏡頭前加了 mist 濾鏡或產生遮蔽眩光，使整體對比下降、黑位抬高與高光邊緣變柔；重點是鏡頭濾鏡感，不是場景天氣。
